name: Orpherus Furst von Marmelade Nahe Gorz
original_name: オルフェレウス・フュルスト・フォン・マルメラーデ・ナーエ・ゲルツ
source:
Sign: Sagittarius
Club: Art

A youth that is in line to become a marquis.
He entered the school in order to join the special Strahl class and learn how to make the world more ideal.
He's childhood friends with [url=/c45330]Eduard[/url].
